metadata.description: CORE — project intelligence in chat with a critic baked in. The `/core` agent plus eight companion utilities.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: CORE — a project intelligence agent that knows your project across sessions, surfaces decisions and risks proactively, and challenges overconfidence. Type `/core` to start. Ships with eight companion utilities — `/finalize`, `/refocus`, `/process-memory`, `/register-sources`, `/vibecheck`, `/configure-project`, `/metrics` (with full/export/self-test modes), and `/memory-view` — that CORE invokes internally and that you can also call directly, plus three deprecation shims: `/metrics-package`, `/self-test`, and `/orient`.
